purpose: Check that Rust shadow-test recommendations reject false green parity.
input_contract: native Python command and structured report path
Rust shadow command and structured report path

given: Python command exits 0 with non-empty report.
Rust command exits 0 with an empty or missing report.

must_not_claim: Do not claim Rust equivalence from exit codes alone.
Do not claim savings when structured same-scope parity is unverified.
promotion_gate: Promote only after regression tests show stale, empty, malformed, and mismatched reports fail closed.
